{{Quote|Communications had been disrupted for four standard days, following the arrival of a Confederacy of Independent Systems flotilla over Balamak, an important food-producing world in the Mid Rim.|HoloNet News Core Edition report|<ref name="RHNN" />}}
'''Balamak''' was an important [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]] on the [[Great Kashyyyk Branch/Legends|Great Kashyyyk Branch]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. During the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Balamak lay in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A [[Unidentified Confederacy of Independent Systems flotilla|Confederate flotilla]] containing the experimental [[CIS Jammer Prototype]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|starship]] was deployed over Balamak during that conflict, disrupting communications in the Taldot [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

In response, a [[Unidentified Galactic Republic task force (Balamak)|Galactic Republic task force]] carried out an [[Battle of Balamak/Legends|attack]] on the [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]]. During the ensuing [[Atmosphere/Legends|stratospheric]] battle, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] destroyed the Jammer Prototype. Balamak later became a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Imperial [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] added it to his [[Greater Maldrood]] dominion. The [[Balamak system/Legends|Balamak system]] was later [[Battle of the Balamak system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Balamak was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Balamak system/Legends|Balamak system]], a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region's]] [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Great Kashyyyk Branch/Legends|Great Kashyyyk Branch]] connected Balamak to the [[Charros system/Legends|Charros system]] as well as the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. Balamak was one of the most bountiful agriworlds of the Mid Rim,<ref name="TEA" /> and it was an important site of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] production.<ref name="RHNN" />

==History==
===The battle over Balamak===
{{Quote|Transmission networks resumed functioning today in the Taldot sector when Republic forces destroyed an experimental jamming platform employed by the Separatists.|HoloNet News Core Edition report|<ref name="RHNN" />}}
Balamak was situated in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]. For [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], the [[Planet/Legends|world]] was fought over by empires that wanted to ensure a steady supply of food for their [[Trooper/Legends|troops]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Balamak lay within territory controlled by the latter, with the Republic's [[Twelfth Army/Legends|Twelfth Sector Army]] being charged with engaging the Confederacy's [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] in Balamak's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW Balamak" />

[[File:BalamakCW-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Balamak, situated in space controlled by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, was the site of a battle during the Clone Wars.]]
In 21.25 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], nine [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Unidentified Confederacy of Independent Systems flotilla|Confederacy flotilla]] arrived over Balamak. One of the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of the formation was the [[CIS Jammer Prototype]], an experimental [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] equipped with a modified [[Transmitter/Legends|transmission array]]. The array broadcast [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] signals that were capable of eliminating a vital [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] node and disrupted the functioning of transmission networks in the Taldot [[Sector/Legends|sector]] for four [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]].<ref name="RHNN" />

In response, the Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] tactician [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] planned an [[Battle of Balamak/Legends|attack]] on the Confederacy [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]]. A [[Unidentified Galactic Republic task force (Balamak)|Republic task force]], led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Nanda-Ree Janoo]], engaged the enemy forces<ref name="RHNN" /> in a [[Atmosphere/Legends|stratospheric]]<ref name="NEC" /> battle<ref name="CSWE Balamak">{{CSWECite|I|56|Balamak}}</ref> on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 14:2:12. During the Republic's starfighter attack, Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] delivered a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] volley that destroyed the CIS Jammer Prototype. The result of the battle was later reported on from<ref name="RHNN" /> the Balamak [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="CSWE Dorum">{{CSWECite|I|201|Dorum}}</ref> [[Dorum]] by the [[HoloNet News Core Edition]],<ref name="RHNN" /> and Tallon's role in planning the attack earned him the title "Victor of Balamak."<ref name="CSWE Balamak" /> However, the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] news and [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] program also labeled the Jammer Prototype's performance at Balamak a successful test of the vessel's capabilities.<ref name="Shadowfeed">{{InsiderCite|65|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:2:14 Edition}}</ref>

===Later history===
Balamak was incorporated in the territory controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW Balamak" /> In order to establish the self-sufficiency of his [[Greater Maldrood]] dominion, established during the Empire's fragmentation in the wake of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Imperial [[High Admiral]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Treuten Teradoc]] took control of Balamak, which served as an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] by that [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="TEA" />

Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the Balamak [[Star system/Legends|system]] numbered between 100 and 500 million. The [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]], as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Battle of the Balamak system|conquered]] the system containing Balamak at some point between 25 ABY and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. The system remained under the control of the invaders by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[36 ABY]], the Clone Wars battle at Balamak was noted in a [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|document]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Balamak was first mentioned as part of Adar Tallon's title, "Victor of Balamak," on the back cover of ''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]'', a [[1988]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Daniel Greenberg]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> It was not until "[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:2:12]]," an article written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] as an [[HoloNet News (Insider)|in-universe news report]], was published that Balamak was identified as a distinct astronomical object. The article was included in the [[Star Wars Insider 65|sixty-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="RHNN" /> on [[January 21]], [[2003]].<ref name="Insider date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20021219.html|text=''Insider'' #65 & ''Bantha Tracks'' #2}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Balamak in grid square Q-9.<ref name="TEA" />
